_metadata.method: Second inference pass with 497-entry base mapping + previous inferences. Contextual analysis of partially-decoded text against English guide (guide_full.txt, latin-1) and Japanese RPG vocabulary. BE uint16 glyph parsing.

606.evidence: R48 MSG 7: ちょう[606]名店 = ちょう有名店 (super famous store). MSG 34: [606]名店 = 有名店 (famous store). 有名 (yuumei = famous/well-known) is a common compound.

629.evidence: R48 MSG 89-92/95/97/105: 異[629]の = 異界の (other world). Consistent location prefix for otherworldly branch shops.

760.evidence: R48 MSG 14-17/25: [760]所の = 近所の (neighborhood). Matches guide NEIGHBORHOOD pattern. Occurs 6 times.

848.evidence: R48 MSG 63: どろ[848]市場 = どろ棒市場 (thief's market). 泥棒 (dorobou=thief) commonly written with 棒 as ateji. A thief's market fits as a low-reputation shop name.

873.evidence: R48 MSG 18: 巨大ゴミ[873]き場 = 巨大ゴミ置き場 (garbage storage/dump site). 置き場 (storage place) is standard Japanese.

320.evidence: R39 MSG 59/66: 信仰[320] must be 信仰心 (faith). R40 MSG 82: [320]のめばえていない = 心のめばえていない (heart hasn't awakened) makes more sense for automata than redundant 芽のめばえ.
